Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the task and selected an option that does not align with the provided choices, rationalizing “B” using Archimedes’ principle instead of the actual text of option B (“calculate the total mass of all of the finished boats”). This reflects a misalignment with the ground truth— the best way to ensure the boats will float without tipping is to build and test a prototype (option A). Additionally, the Planner prematurely marked the task complete and ignored the instruction to choose a specialist and follow a stepwise process.
